attempted_claim: In the Eisenstein field K=Q(sqrt(-3)) with ring Z[omega], for prime elements pi1,pi2,pi3 of norm below 5000, pairwise distinct up to units and associates, each congruent to 1 mod 3 in the sense of Amano-Mizusawa-Morishita with all pairwise cubic residue symbols equal to 1: determine with proof whether the mod-3 triple cubic residue symbol [pi1,pi2,pi3]_3 is nontrivial (not equal to 1) with nonvanishing mod-3 triple Milnor invariant and Massey product in Galois cohomology. A complete answer exhibits one explicit prime-element triple plus norm factorizations, the full pairwise cubic-symbol table, the mod-3 Heisenberg degree-27 extension with ramification exactly at pi1,pi2 and defining equations, and the decomposition witness for pi3 establishing the claimed triple value, or proves no such triple exists in the stated norm bound.
decisive_failure: No Heisenberg degree-27 extension was constructed: the certified tower has Galois closure of degree 81 and is ramified above 3. The observed fiber-constant central values are uncertified computations, not theorems, and all code is exploratory rather than independently verified.
